notes.title: Post playtest patch
notes.content:
New Features

Segment Filter Upgrades
Implemented segment purchase probability filters with three new research items in the research tree.
Reputation Tutorial
Implemented a new tutorial to help you understand how reputation affects your business.
New Area Reveal Animation

Improvements

Tutorial Enhancements

 Updated tutorials to explain night actions and highlight key features like the research tab, sales summary, and city navigation.
 Replaced Master Lee's portrait with a new character, Secretary Grace, for research tutorial intros.

Research Tab Enhancements

 Added higher-tier research overlays to clearly indicate locked tiers.
 Enhanced research shortcut buttons and added subtle focus visual effects to assist in navigation.
 Reduced research VFX size and updated the "currently researching" icon.

Goal System Updates

 Balanced demo goals to be slightly more challenging over 15 days.
 Added goal completion and failure sound effects and visual confetti celebrations.
 Made the goal tracker clickable, directing you to the goals screen.
 Updated goal tips design and added Master Lee for guidance.

User Interface Improvements

 Changed "Supplies" terminology to "Inventory" where appropriate.
 Moved Inventory Calculator to Tier 1 in the research tree for earlier access.
 Fixed text positioning and alignment in Finance, Banking, and other screens.
 Adjusted hotkeys according to the design document and implemented hotkey customization.
 Added modular focus highlights and borders to various UI elements for better visual cues.

notes.title: Patch 0.154.3
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the tooltip would sometimes cause an error in the "Move Here" tab.
 Improved tracking for a bug that stops the game from saving properly. (Note: This does not fix the bug, but now shows an error when the game doesn't save.)
 Added logging to help track an error related to employee training and provide details of all stand locations owned by the player. (Note: This does not fix the bug but helps identify the issue.)
 Improved error handling for a component that tracks stand details, now showing the overall business graph if the stand data is missing. (Note: This does not fix the bug but helps us understand why the data is missing.)
 Implemented a potential fix for a bug where the music might start playing before the audio system is ready.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Scrolling with the mouse wheel will now only work when the pointer is on the environment area.
 The special keys Zero and Equal that enable cheat codes have been removed.
